gen-gf-revalia-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono reads large and loose, its bowls left unfinished on one side. Revalia strides across the top in bold, widely separated letters, and the monospace body follows with flat, structured precision.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-viga: Revalia's lowercase g leaves its lower curve open, and the bold letters stride on widely spaced. Viga, a plain sans without hairlines, stays quiet while Revalia shows off in big, short headings.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-voces: Revalia is bold and expressive, its g leaving the lower curve open and its letters widely separated. And Voces, built tall with stems and hairlines close in weight, lets paragraphs unspool without fuss.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough sets its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, a contemporary plain sans that feels brisk on the line. Revalia above it swaggers in bold, widely spaced display letters.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-winky-sans: Revalia's g keeps its lower curve open, and its bold letters stride along with generous gaps between them. And Revalia is built to grab attention, while Winky Sans, with capitals barely taller than lowercase, is built for reading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-yantramanav: Yantramanav is a modern sans whose lowercase nearly reaches the capitals, with open terminal gaps in its rounded letters. Yantramanav keeps tight company under Revalia, whose bold, widely spaced letters take the loud part.
gen-gf-revalia-outfit: Outfit reads clean and approachable, its curves bent like cable and finishing well before they close. Outfit against Revalia gives a tall, bold, widely spaced heading over a moderate-height body of uniform tubing.
gen-gf-revalia-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, a monoline sans-serif whose curve endings stay well apart. But Revalia is the loud one, bold and expressive, and that gap in temperament is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-revalia-sora: Loud on top, quietly geometric below, and nothing fussy. Revalia's bold, widely spaced letters hold the stage while Sora, a plain sans with no pressure swell at the corners, simply keeps its line steady.
gen-gf-revalia-space-grotesk: Revalia's lowercase g leaves its lower curve open, and its bold, widely spaced letters sit tall. Space Grotesk, a sans with moderate lowercase height, can take a slightly larger body size so its open counters keep breathing.
